CacheControl.description:
`company.domain`: a `no-cache` or `no-store` token (comma-separated)
skips the result-cache read. Other tokens are ignored. Same effect as
`X-Router-Cache: bypass` or body `skip_cache: true`.
CacheControl.name: Cache-Control

IdempotencyKey.description:
Optional replay key, honored on every capability `POST`. Any
non-empty string; keys are scoped to the tenant. The request hash
covers the capability, the parsed input, `routing`, the effective
credit ceiling (including `X-Router-Max-Provider-Credits`),
`dry_run`, `compliance`, and which caller credentials were sent
(names only).

- Same key + same hash on a completed run replays it
  (`replayed: true`, no new charge). A free `no_decision` miss is
  re-run instead of replayed.
- Same key + a different hash (including another capability):
  `409 idempotency_conflict`.
- Same key while the first call is still running:
  `409 idempotency_in_flight`. A run with no activity for ~40 s is
  treated as abandoned: re-run if no paid vendor was contacted,
  else `409 idempotency_spent`.
- Same key after a failed run that already contacted a paid vendor:
  `409 idempotency_spent` (an unpaid failure is re-run).
- Completed run that cannot be loaded:
  `409 idempotency_replay_unavailable`.

429 / 503: back off and retry the same key (the run was not
started). Salesforce: Named Cred Custom Header is the fallback if
the External Services import does not surface it
(`docs/salesforce-named-cred.md`).
IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

RouterCache.description:
`company.domain` only. `bypass` skips the short-TTL in-isolate result-cache
read so the call re-runs (still writes the fresh answer). Does **not**
skip `Idempotency-Key` replay — omit or rotate that header on Janus
first-100 re-smokes. Same effect as `Cache-Control: no-cache` / `no-store`
or body `skip_cache: true`. Other values are `400 invalid_cache`.
RouterCache.name: X-Router-Cache

RouterExplain.description:
Response verbosity. Omitted or `default` is the clean v2 envelope (no `trace`).
`full` adds `trace` (decision, attempts, candidates, routing, writer, explain).
`minimal` is accepted as an alias of `default` so Salesforce Flow
`X-Router-Explain: minimal` keeps working. Same enum as `explain` query.
If both are set they must match after aliasing.
RouterExplain.name: X-Router-Explain

RouterExplainQuery.description:
Same semantics as `X-Router-Explain`. Use when the caller cannot set a custom header
(Clay HTTP columns). If both header and query are set they must match or the
response is `400 invalid_explain`. A JSON body field `explain` is also
`400 invalid_explain` (hint: use this query or `X-Router-Explain`, not the body).
RouterExplainQuery.name: explain

RouterMaxProviderCredits.description:
Caller credit ceiling for this call, for callers that cannot set
body `routing.max_provider_credits`. A finite number ≥ 0; anything
else is `400 invalid_routing` (`field: X-Router-Max-Provider-Credits`).
An empty value is ignored.

- company.resolve / domain / hierarchy / b2b_social / x_account /
  description and person.verify_employment: used only when the body
  has no `routing.max_provider_credits` (the body wins). It replaces
  the tenant / path default (it can raise it) and is clamped to the
  server ceiling.
- person.title / name / b2b_social / email and email.verify: the
  lowest of the path cap, the server ceiling, this header and the
  body value applies (it can only lower the cap).

Not declared on company.icon, person.language or person.phone: they
use fixed path caps and ignore it (a malformed value is still
`400 invalid_routing`). The effective ceiling is part of the
`Idempotency-Key` request hash.
RouterMaxProviderCredits.name: X-Router-Max-Provider-Credits

RouterSchema.description:
Request-pinned envelope version. Omit = current tip (today `2`).
Pin `2` locks the v2 envelope (`ok`, `schema_version`, `answer`,
`es_decision`, `result` flats, `sources`, `usage` including `hops` /
`providers_ran`). Unknown values are `400 unsupported_schema` (run
not started; Idempotency-Key not spent). Must agree with query
`schema` and body `schema_version` when those are set.
Named Cred: optional static Custom Header `X-Router-Schema` = `2`.
RouterSchema.name: X-Router-Schema

RouterSchemaQuery.description:
Same as `X-Router-Schema`. Use when the caller cannot set a custom header.
Header, query, and body `schema_version` must agree when more than one is set.
RouterSchemaQuery.name: schema

AdditionalDomainProof.description: Additive per-host proof for a write-safe additional domain. Not a write gate; completeness is additional_domains_status.

hint.description: Non-PII hint when already stored (e.g. email:@smoke.kingminos.invalid). Absent or null otherwise. Never a raw email or URL.

kind.description: liurl short links and /pub/ URLs store as li.

reason.description: Why the suppression is being lifted (audited).

AdminSignup.description: One signup. Contains personal data (email). Explicit allowlist; no hashes, Stripe ids, IP, ASN, or user agent.

credit_balance.description: Owner workspace balance (user balance when no workspace).

total_runs.description: Runs recorded for the owner workspace.

welcome_onboarding_credits.description: Sum of ledger credits with memo trial or onboarding:*.

work_email.description: classifyEmail(email) === work (not personal, disposable, or invalid).

columns.description: The allowlisted column names, in CSV order.

Answer.description: The one block to read. Employment automations branch on `outcome`. Salesforce / stamp-safe callers use `es_decision` (also top-level). `summary` is explain-only — machines must not use it as control flow.

identity.description: company.description only. Identity basis for the stamp. Null on an unjudged hit (still a hit when confidence meets the floor).

outcome.description: Capability outcome. Employment automations branch here: high_confidence_send | low_confidence_send | low_confidence_block | high_confidence_block | no_decision. Company resolve: resolved | resolved_without_primary_id | no_decision.

reason_code.description: Closed reason (decision.reason, or company.domain domain_verdict / reject_reason when more specific).

summary.description: Human one-liner (provider / path / outcome; notes material skips such as "<provider> not called" only when that provider was planned). Present on every completed decision. Explain only — control stays `answer.outcome` / `es_decision` / reason_code.

rate_limit.description: Honest ZoomInfo `X-RateLimit-*` fields from this hop. Omitted when the vendor sent none (isolate-bucket skip has no headers). Never invents remaining/limit from the registry.

AttemptStatus.description:
Provider attempt ending. Maps to the four-way field vocabulary:
- ok / cached ≈ completed (value found or replayed)
- empty ≈ no_result (processing finished, nothing found)
- error / rate_limited / timeout ≈ failed
- skipped ≈ skipped (budget, not configured, or excluded by routing)

AttributionField.description: Fixed allowlist of public result fields that may appear in `sources`. Rows are omitted when the value is null. Do not invent fields absent from this capability's public result.

AttributionOperation.description: Provider operation that produced the value, or `request` for request-echo.

AttributionProvider.description: Where the value came from. `request` is documented request-echo (expected_company_* only). Provider-sourced values use the ProviderName that filled the field (`zoominfo` | `leadmagic` | `websearch` | `findymail` | `wiza` | `aiark`).

candidates.description: Every considered company page with its source (homepage / search / vendor / rejected). Present on hits so a local agent can self-verify.

hint.description: Operator hint on a miss (never a top-level next_steps field).

homepage_fetch.description: Per-step Worker homepage fetch diagnostics (status, URL, bytes, UA). `linkedin_check` is a cached LinkedIn outcome when we already have one (`status`, `http_status`, `reason`). The request path never GETs linkedin.com (`not_run` / `not_fetched`). `rendered` is set when accuracy/coverage ran Browser Rendering (`status`, `latency_ms`, `browser_ms`, `links_found`).

source.description: homepage_link | homepage_rendered | linkedin_redirect | search_rank_N | vendor | name_domain

sources.description: Signals that agreed on result.linkedin_url (homepage_link, homepage_rendered, search, vendor, listed_website, cached_redirect). A local agent uses this to decide whether to self-verify.

linkedin_url.description: Accept form `https://www.linkedin.com/company/{slug}` (slug lowercased), or null. Homepage-confirmed, search-ranked, or vendor-accepted. Never `/in/`, school, showcase, or a parent page for a distinct unit.

unverified.description: Search candidates the web search could not confirm. Not hits.

BillingMode.description:
Vendor billing for a hop. `always` = cost applies on each attempt (even empty);
`on_success` = vendor bills only when a result is found. Request
`max_provider_credits` is a reservation ceiling; `usage.provider_credits` is the
reconciled bill after the run.

country.description: Optional ISO country for name→domain disambiguation.

domain.description: Preferred subject (or website/email that hygiene-normalize to the same registrable).

hint.description: Optional list/industry context for name→domain (e.g. "UK PR agency"). Any path uses it with `country` so short names like WPR resolve; on speed/balance it also turns name→domain on.

linkedin_url.description: Optional company-page hint. Must already be `https://www.linkedin.com/company/{slug}` after `normalizeLinkedInCompanyUrl`. Person `/in/` is 400. Agree-check only — not authority to invent.

name.description: Unit/brand corroboration. Sufficient as the only subject (accuracy/coverage resolve name→domain; speed/balance do too when `hint` is sent). Unhinted speed/balance miss rather than guess when domain/website/email are absent.

external_ref.description: Client correlation key (round-trip on the run response).

path.description: Flattened alias of `routing.path`. Omit = `balance`. Nested `routing.path` wins when both are sent.

preset.description: Flattened alias of `routing.preset`. Nested wins when both are sent.

domain.description: Required subject (or website/email that hygiene-normalize to the same registrable).

max_chars.description: Truncate at a sentence boundary. Never cut mid-sentence.

name.description: Optional hint for accuracy compose. Not returned.

external_ref.description: Client correlation key (round-trip on the run response).

skip_cache.description: When true, skip the 30-day `company.description` result-cache read and re-run the call. Still writes the fresh answer. Same effect as `X-Router-Cache: bypass` or `Cache-Control: no-cache|no-store`. Non-boolean is `400 invalid_cache`.

family_policy.description: How alias / regional / family facts map to CRM shape. Omit = collapse_brand (alias and regional → additional_domains; HubSpot domain may lift to the brand primary). separate_regional keeps the regional as a child (`parent_domain` set). Included in the request hash and domain-cache key.

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn company page URL (`linkedin.com/company/...`); person `/in/` URLs are rejected

name.description: Optional company name. Alias `company_name` is accepted. With a clean domain, the router checks that the name and host are the same company. Alone (or with a junk host) on `balance` or deeper, it may discover a unique domain — or abstain. `speed` does not discover.

external_ref.description: Client correlation key (round-trip on the run response).

path.description: Flattened alias of `routing.path` (Workflows / Clay / Cap). Same expand and `400 invalid_routing` rules. Nested `routing.path` wins when both are sent. `coverage` is a live product path (accuracy + related-domain recall).

preset.description: Flattened alias of `routing.preset`. Nested wins when both are sent.

schema_version.description: Optional envelope pin. Same as `X-Router-Schema`. Omit = current tip. Must agree with the header / query when those are set.

skip_cache.description: When true, skip the short-TTL `company.domain` result-cache read and re-run the call. Still writes the fresh answer. Does not skip `Idempotency-Key` replay — omit or rotate that header on Janus first-100 re-smokes. Same effect as `X-Router-Cache: bypass` or `Cache-Control: no-cache|no-store`. Non-boolean is `400 invalid_cache`.

CompanyDomainRoutingRequest.description: company.domain routing. Canonical product paths are `speed` / `balance` / `accuracy` / `coverage`. Legacy aliases: `fast`/`value` → `speed`, `auto` → `balance`. Same other fields as RoutingRequest.

path.description: company.domain product path. Omit = `balance`. Canonical: `speed` (hygiene → DNS → site_probe, 0 credits), `balance` (adds a 0-credit company lookup), `accuracy` (cap 3, adds miss-only discovery plus optional enrichment step), `coverage` (cap 4, accuracy plus related-domain recall — more ownership-proven additional_domains, often `partial`). Legacy: `fast` / `value` / `name_only` → `speed`, `auto` → `balance`. See docs/company-domain.md.

preset.description: Back-compat alias of `path` plus `zi_stamp` (optional ZoomInfo-first), `name_only` / `fast` (→ `speed`), and `auto` (→ `balance`). Prefer `path` on new callers.

domain.description: Null when the hierarchy answer carries no website.

external_ref.description: Client correlation key (round-trip on the run response).

path.description: Flattened alias of `routing.path`. Nested wins when both are sent.

preset.description: Flattened alias of `routing.preset`. Nested wins when both are sent.

domain.description: Required subject (or website/email that hygiene-normalize to the same registrable).

external_ref.description: Client correlation key (round-trip on the run response).

operator_confidence.description:
high = two independent claims (e.g. copyright + preheader / makers_of /
footer link). medium = one claim plus twitter:creator. low = one claim.

operator_domain.description: Registrable domain linked on the site whose label matches the name.

operator_name.description: Operator as written on the site, legal suffix dropped (`37signals`).

operator_source.description:
Strongest name-bearing claim. `copyright_footer` (© YEAR X LLC/Inc),
`preheader` ("from X" in the title or top of page), `makers_of`
("X, makers of …" / "a X product"). `footer_link` and `zoominfo`
are reserved (supporting evidence today; not emitted as the source).

operator_zoominfo_company_id.description: ZoomInfo company id for `operator_domain` (0-credit exact_one search; null when ZoomInfo is off this call or misses).

domain.description: Also accepts email-shaped strings (domain extracted after @)

email.description: Typical caller input; domain derived via normalizeDomain

name.description: Accepted on the request; name-only (no domain/email/website) is no_decision / no_domain and does not search

external_ref.description: Client correlation key (round-trip on the run response).

company_domain.description:
Flat resolved company domain (key always present; null on miss).
Optional CRM hygiene — never clobber an existing Website/domain.

company_name.description:
Flat resolved company name (key always present; null on miss).
Account Name fill-if-blank when present — including on
`es_decision=miss` (websearch-only name). Do not wait for hit.
Stamp id only on hit + non-blank `zoominfo_company_id`.

operator.description:
Who owns / operates the site behind the brand (fizzy.do → 37signals).
Additive; never changes `company_name`. Null when the operator is the
brand itself or no aligned ownership claim was found. 0 credits.

zoominfo_company_id.description:
Flat ZoomInfo company id (null when absent).
Salesforce stamp only when `es_decision=hit` and this value is non-blank.

domain.description: Preferred subject (or website/email that hygiene-normalize to the same registrable).

min_confidence.description: Overrides the path confidence floor (speed/coverage `low`, balance `medium`, accuracy `high`). Omit = path default.

name.description: Unit/brand corroboration. Sufficient as the only subject (accuracy/coverage resolve name→domain). Speed/balance miss rather than guess when domain/website/email are absent.

x_url.description: Optional account hint. Must already be `https://x.com/{handle}` after `normalizeXAccountUrl`. Agree-check only.

external_ref.description: Client correlation key (round-trip on the run response).

answer.description: Same control block as Answer, without `safe_to_write`. Confidence is the only write signal.

ComplianceRequest.description:
Optional request-level vendor gate (not a routing path). Omit the object
for today's unconstrained behavior. Only keys set to `true` constrain;
missing keys and `false` are ignored. v1 fields: `soc2`, `data`.
Unknown keys or non-boolean values → `400 invalid_compliance`.
Constrained hops that lack a house attestation skip as
`compliance_blocked` (not `provider_error`). Matrix: `docs/compliance.md`.

data.description: When true, every considered hop must publish a customer DPA and/or a thorough public privacy policy / terms covering personal-data processing. Not a naked GDPR claim.

soc2.description: When true, every considered hop must have a house SOC 2 attestation.

Decision.description: Capability decision. Employment automations branch on `outcome`. Salesforce / stamp-safe callers use top-level `es_decision` instead. `summary` is explain-only — machines must not use it as control flow. Do not parse nested evidence or attempts for control flow.

outcome.description: Capability outcome. Employment automations branch here: high_confidence_send | low_confidence_send | low_confidence_block | high_confidence_block | no_decision. Company resolve: resolved | resolved_without_primary_id | no_decision. Do not parse nested evidence or attempts for control flow.

candidates.description: Ranked candidates on conflict or a below-floor withhold.

compose_echo.description: Compose was near-identical to a cheaper quoted hit. The compose may still stamp.

description.description: English, JSON-safe description. Null on miss.

flags.description: Hit-only quality flags. `hype` when the judge's hype score > 0.7 or leftover superlatives. First-person / second-person / leftover CTA is rewritten to third person or the hop misses — a stamped hit has `first_person` and `cta` false. `tagline` covers slogans, all-caps headlines, blog headlines, and article summaries. `same_as_speed` marks a ranked fallback that matches the speed winner. `truncated` means the stamp was trimmed to the last whole word and forces confidence `low`. `grammar` is informational and does not affect confidence. Confidence lives on `answer.confidence` (`high` | `medium` | `low`) and is the write signal.

homepage_meta_only.description: Homepage evidence was only a meta/og tag (no distinct JSON-LD / hero / about).

DomainEvidence.description: Why we classified a host. Site pointers (canonical / og / hreflang), registry ownership, a corroborated redirect, the input host redirecting to this stamp (`input_redirects_here`), a same-id ZoomInfo host that is also name-tied, or a shared tracking-id that is name-tied and live can put a host on additional_domains, as can distinctive self-hosted NS/MX. A homepage outbound link (`homepage_cross_link`) is not enough on its own — it needs a name-tie or a second independent proof. Shared tracking-id or a vendor portfolio id alone never does. `brand_tied` + `live` without that proof stay on review_domains. Vendor and registry claims are evidence, never the decision.

DomainExplain.description: Structured company.domain explain payload. Machines must not use it as control flow (`decision.summary` is also explain-only). No 0–100 scores.

family_notes.description: Explain-only lines for non-unknown account-identity domains.

rule_why.description: Deterministic one-liner for why this rule_id fired.

no_web.description: Registered (not NXDOMAIN) with no usable A/AAAA/CNAME/MX at apex or www.

DomainOutcome.description: Product answer. `verified` / `corrected` / `discovered` are write-safe (`es_decision=hit`; `result.company_domain` / `verified_domain` stamped). `rejected` is a confident refusal of junk input (`es_decision=reject` — do not write `input_domain`). `unverified` is a hold (`es_decision=miss` — mismatch, unconfirmed, dead, parked, no_web, sources disagree). `no_decision` is an honest abstain. See docs/company-domain.md.

account_key.description: List-level join key. `zoominfo:{id}` of the account primary when proven, else `domain:{account_primary_domain}`. Distinct from row-level entity_key. Not a CRM write.

account_primary_domain.description: Account primary under family_policy. Null when no trusted stamp. HubSpot `domain` maps here. company_domain / verified_domain stay the row's trusted host and can differ when collapse_brand lifts a regional to a stronger brand primary.

additional_domain_proofs.description: Additive. Per-host proof tags for additional_domains (redirect, hreflang, canonical, og_url, zi_same_id, name_tied_live, tracking_id, homepage_link, ns_or_mx). Completeness is additional_domains_status — proofs are not a write gate. Omitted when empty.

additional_domains.description: Ownership-proven write-safe aliases / regionals only. Caller joins: HubSpot `hs_additional_domains` ← additional_domains.join(";"). Brand-tied + live without ownership never appears here (see review_domains). Shared tracking-id or a vendor portfolio id alone never appears here. Not “all domains found.” Never includes the input host or its www/apex twins. Also omits the stamped company_domain, canonical_domain, account_primary_domain, and their www/apex twins, except when the input host HTTP-redirects to a different registrable domain that passed identity — then that redirect target (in practice `company_domain` when it differs from the input) is included with proof `redirect`. Same-site redirects (www, http→https) and identity-mismatch redirects add nothing.

additional_domains_csv.description: Always present on every `company.domain` 200 response (hit, miss, reject, or withhold). Flat comma-separated list of the same ownership-proven hosts as additional_domains (lowercase, deduped, stable sort, at most six hosts). Never includes the input host. Omits the stamped company_domain, canonical_domain, account_primary_domain, and www/apex twins, except the domain the input HTTP-redirects to when that cross-domain redirect passed identity (typically `company_domain` when it differs from the input). Same-site redirects and identity-mismatch redirects add nothing. Truncates at 255 characters on whole-domain boundaries for Salesforce `Secondary_Domains__c`. Never includes review_domains or related_domains. Use empty string (`""`) when `additional_domains_status` is `skipped` or there are no proven additional domains — never omitted, never null.

additional_domains_status.description: Always present on every `company.domain` 200 response. Sweep completeness only — not a write-safety signal. `skipped` = no trusted stamp (lists empty; `additional_domains_csv` is `""`). `complete` = the published variant sweep finished. `partial` = we stopped early (time budget, hung identity hop, or a credit-cap skip of a planned hop) — membership in additional_domains / additional_domains_csv is what is write-safe; do not treat the list as exhaustive; not cached as complete. An optional corroborator (BuiltWith, Wikidata, GLEIF, RDAP) that errors or returns empty does not by itself force `partial`.

alternate_domains.description: Read-only other hosts (input / vendor_primary / redirect / discovered) with attributions. Empty when only one host was considered. Never stamps company_domain.

canonical_domain.description: Read-only. Vendor primary, the stamped host, or the sole considered host. Not a write-gate substitute — do not treat as company_domain unless verified_domain is also stamped.

company_domain.description: Trusted host (replaces verified_domain). Null unless the outcome is trusted (`verified` / `corrected` / `discovered`). Overlay finds are discovered_domain only. Map HubSpot Company domain / website here only when non-null. HubSpot `domain` (account primary) maps from account_primary_domain — the two can differ under collapse_brand.

company_name.description: CRM-safe display name when we have one. On a trusted domain stamp, prefers a gated site-claim brand (og:site_name or title brand keyword-strong / name-tied to the stamped host). One weak title alone does not stamp. Null when we have no writeable name.

corrected_via.description: How the corrected host was proven (HTTP redirect, DNS CNAME, rel=canonical, or og:url). Null unless outcome is corrected.

discovered_domain.description: Half-trusted name→domain find on overlay rows (junk reject, name mismatch, dead, or no-web host). Review / Cap / Clay side column only — do not write as company_domain or HubSpot domain. Null when the outcome is trusted (the write lives on company_domain) or when discovery abstained.

entity_key.description: Read-only join key. `zoominfo:{id}` when a ZoomInfo company id is in hand, else `domain:{canonical_domain}`. Not a CRM write.

family_policy.description: Echo of the request policy (default collapse_brand). Controls whether regionals land in additional_domains or stay a child (`separate_regional` + parent_domain).

input_domain.description: What the caller sent (normalized host when we could parse one). Never write this to HubSpot when outcome is rejected. Equals `input_domain` when `answer.reason_code` is `corrected`.

parent_domain.description: HubSpot parent-company lookup key when this row is the child. Null unless a parent (or, under separate_regional, a brand primary) is set.

related_domains.description: Subsidiary / parent / sister (and regional under separate_regional). Parent/child review — not a domain merge.

review_domains.description: Brand-tied and live but ownership not proven, or a homepage outbound link without a name-tie or second proof (`homepage_cross_link_unproven`). Human review column — do not merge into HubSpot hs_additional_domains.

rule_id.description: Greppable rule id (e.g. R10_corrected, R04_social_profile). Audit / support — not a write gate. See docs/company-domain.md.

zoominfo_company_id.description: ZoomInfo company id whenever this run used a ZI company hit (corroboration or discover). Not gated on trusted outcomes or `zi_stamp`. Optional id stamp. Null when ZoomInfo missed or the only ZI id belongs to a different host than the stamped domain (R10 corrected away from the ZI host).

EmailVerifyExplain.description: Present on `trace.explain` only when `X-Router-Explain` / `?explain=` is `full`. Default responses omit it.

local_check.description: The local check that decided a free `invalid`.

dry_run.description: Offline and instant — no DNS or vendor check.

email.description: The mailbox to check. Canonicalized (lower-cased, look-alike host spellings folded) before the suppression check and the vendor checks. A malformed address is answered (`invalid`, `source: local`, 0 credits), not rejected.

external_ref.description: Client correlation key (round-trip on the run response).

routing.description: `path` picks speed | balance | accuracy | coverage ( omit = balance). `only` / `ignore` isolate vendors (an unknown provider is `400 unknown_provider`). `max_provider_credits` below the path price is `max_credits_reached` (noop, 0 credits).

candidates.description: One row per vendor check — provider, hop status, and the normalized verdict when it answered.

confidence.description: Two agreeing checks = high; one = medium; conflicting checks = low (status `unknown`). Kept on a below-floor withhold.

email.description: The normalized address (lower-cased), or the trimmed input when it did not parse.

mx_provider.description: Mailbox provider reported by the check (for example `google`, `microsoft`).

source.description: `local` = a free DNS / syntax `invalid`; `vendor` = a delivered vendor check.

status.description: `catch_all`, `unknown`, and a withheld below-floor answer bill 0; the answer's `reason_code` says why (ambiguous, zero_hits, sources_disagree, below_min_confidence, provider_error, …).

linkedin_source.description: How the LinkedIn URL was resolved for the job-change check (when applicable)

days_at_job.description: Vendor tenure in days, when the hop returned one

start_date.description: Vendor current-position start date, when the hop returned one

EmploymentExplain.description: person.verify_employment explain. Present when `X-Router-Explain` or `?explain=` is `minimal` or `full`. Explain-only — not control flow.

speed_domain_check.description: Speed path only — mailbox domain vs the corrected expected company domain

company_domain.description: Flat current-company domain; null when current employer is unknown

company_name.description: Flat current-company name; null when current employer is unknown

current_company.description: Current employer when the provider supplied one. On `changed`, this is the new employer or explicitly null when unknown — key is always present; never invented.

email_validation.description: Layer-1 bounce / catch-all / SEG / role fields when present

employment.description: Layer-2 employment signal from job-change when that hop ran. Send/block is `answer.outcome`. Catch-all / SEG / role live on `email_validation` and `answer.summary`.

evidence.description: Audit/debug only — do not parse for automation control flow. Present on default / `X-Router-Explain: full`. Omitted on `minimal`.

person.description: Known person fields (title / LinkedIn when present). Present on changed even when current_company is null.

soft_miss.description: Deterministic label on every completed run. Not a fifth send/block outcome. `vendor_conflict` when email / employment / corroboration sources disagree.

zoominfo_contact_id.description: Optional ZoomInfo contact id attached after the employment decision (`continueForContactId`). Presence is not required for `es_decision: hit`. Id-append only — does not change `decision.outcome`, `result.employment`, or confidence. Null when ZoomInfo misses, errors, or is not configured.

ErrorBody.description:
Error envelope. `error` is the code to branch on. `hint` is the one
human sentence. `detail` appears only on 401 (missing | malformed |
mismatch). `details` holds structured extras. Optional `run_id` when a
run exists. Never echoes the API key. 429s send `Retry-After`. Same
shape as `openapi.es.yaml` ErrorBody.

detail.description:
401 only. missing — no Authorization (Salesforce Custom Headers
empty); malformed — not Bearer <token>; mismatch — key did not match.

details.description: Optional structured extras on non-401 errors.

hint.description: One human sentence saying what to do next. Never a secret. Do not branch on it; branch on `error`.

retryable.description: True on 429 and 5xx (including credential_broker_* 503s and store_unavailable). Flow may retry the same Idempotency-Key.

run_id.description: Present when the error names a run.

EsDecision.description: Salesforce / stamp-safe branch. Mapped from capability outcome + reason. company.resolve `resolved` → hit only when a safe primary ZoomInfo id is present (`result.zoominfo_company_id`); `resolved_without_primary_id` → miss (do not stamp). Employment four-way send/block → hit even when `result.zoominfo_contact_id` is null (contact id is optional enrichment, not a stamp-safe-id gate). `hit` only stamps a primary ZoomInfo company id when `result.zoominfo_company_id` is present. Account Name fill-if-blank only when `es_decision=hit` **and** `result.company_name` non-blank. Budget / routing / compliance skips (`max_credits_reached`, `not_configured`, `insufficient_input`, `compliance_blocked`) → noop on both company.resolve and person.verify_employment — not error. company.hierarchy `subsidiary` / `ultimate_parent` → `hit`; `no_hierarchy_data` / `no_match` → `miss`; `sources_disagree` / `ambiguous` → `ambiguous`; `provider_unavailable` → `error`. company.domain `rejected` → `reject` (confident refusal, not an absence). Existing Account Flows branching `hit / miss / else` route `reject` to `else`. person.language `hit` → `hit`; `ambiguous` (low-only evidence) → `ambiguous`; `zero_hits` / `person_mismatch` → `miss`. person.title `hit` → `hit`; `fields_incomplete` / `ambiguous` → `ambiguous`; `zero_hits` / `person_mismatch` → `miss`. Do not use this field as the employment automation branch — use `decision.outcome`.

capability.description:
A live KingMinos capability id (e.g. company.description).
Required for `data_quality`.

details.description: Free text. Stays in KingMinos (admin review only); keep personal data and secrets out.

requested.description: The provider, endpoint or field they wanted. Required for `provider_request` / `endpoint_request`.

run_id.description: Links the report to the exact call. Required in practice for data-quality reports; must be a run the caller's tenant owns.

source.description: user = the person's own words; agent = something the agent noticed.

summary.description:
Plain-English headline with no IDs or error text, so similar
reports group together. This is what triage shows.

task_context.description: What they were trying to do, without the actual values.

deduped.description: True when an identical same-day report was replayed instead of filed again.

feedback_id.description: `fb_…` id. Quote it when following up.

enum: Thanks, the KingMinos team reviews this.

FieldAttribution.description: Explain-only: where a populated public result field came from (SEP / Clay / Flow). Not a dump of attempts. Machines must not use sources as control flow.

observed_at.description: When this field was observed (attempt time, else run time)

GuidanceResponse.description: Public agent/caller guidance. Generated from `src/guidance.ts`. Section hashes on `guide` match `sections` keys.

confidence.description: Levels plus `how` (the checks that ran) and `ask_user`. Confidence is corroboration found, not a quality hedge.

HierarchyOutcome.description: Never “standalone”. No parent + no subsidiaries is `no_decision` / `no_hierarchy_data`.

family_tree_size.description: Raw hierarchy node count before truncate (null on speed).

flags.description: Hit-only. `low_res` when the source short side is below 64. Not a miss; confidence is `low` and the default floor still returns it.

pending_render.description: URL is final (`/i/d/<sha256(domain)>.png`); image still rendering. Placeholder (short TTL) until it lands; monogram if rendering fails.

icon_source_height.description: Source raster height in pixels before the 256 canvas / 2× cap.

icon_source_url.description: Original third-party URL the copy was fetched from. Audit only — do not stamp this.

icon_source_width.description: Source raster width in pixels before the 256 canvas / 2× cap.

icon_url.description: Hosted HTTPS 256×256 PNG on logos.kingminos.com (`/i/<sha256>.png`). Null on miss. Never a third-party URL.

id_type.description: company_id | contact_id | url (responses use snake_case id_type)

IncompleteRunResponse.description: GET /v1/runs/:id while the run is `running` or `failed` (no decision row). Inspect status, error, usage. answer / result / es_decision are null. `trace` only on `explain=full`. Not imported by External Services.

query.description: Unquoted web-search query used for confirmation (domain-keyed).

reason.description: Stable code such as serp_title_snippet, serp_no_match, not_in_serp, person_profile, not_linkedin, serper_unavailable.

url.description: Normalized company-page URL when structural check passed.

MinConfidence.description: Optional write floor. Overrides the path default (speed / coverage / no-path = low, balance = medium, accuracy = high). A candidate below the floor is withheld: the field is blank, `answer.confidence` stays the withheld value, candidates stay in evidence, and the run bills as that capability's miss.

endpoint.description: HTTP path for `capability` (e.g. `/v1/person/b2b-social`, `/v1/person/name`). Additive; same value as CAPABILITY_HTTP_PATHS.

est_credits.description: Expected credits for the suggested call, from the path price constants (never a hard-coded guess). Not the path ceiling.

inputs.description: Request fields to send. Known values are echoed from this call. A field produced by a previous step is an object `{ from_endpoint, from_field }` (e.g. linkedin_url from `/v1/person/b2b-social` `result.linkedin_url`).

max_credits.description: Path credit ceiling for the suggested call.

PersonB2bSocialExplain.description: Present on `trace.explain` only when `X-Router-Explain` / `?explain=` is `full`. Default responses omit it. Rejected rows are compared normalised name tokens — no URL, slug, or email.

PersonB2bSocialRequest.description: `email` is required (top level or under `person`). `linkedin_url`, `first_name`, `last_name`, and `company_domain` are match-only identity gates — never a discovery key.

company_domain.description: Match-only employer hint. A vendor profile at another registrable domain flags `employer_mismatch` and caps high at medium — not a hard miss.

dry_run.description: Offline and instant — no vendor hops, not cached.

external_ref.description: Client correlation key (round-trip on the run response).

first_name.description: Match-only; never infers or scores anything.

last_name.description: Match-only; never infers or scores anything. Both last names present and sharing no token (accent fold, umlaut transliteration, ignore a parenthetical maiden name) is `person_mismatch`.

linkedin_url.description: Match-only. A resolved profile with another slug is rejected (`person_mismatch`). Company pages are 400.

routing.description: `path` picks speed | balance | accuracy | coverage ( omit = balance). `only` / `ignore` isolate vendors (an unknown provider is `400 unknown_provider`). `max_provider_credits` below the path price is `max_credits_reached` (noop, 0 credits).

skip_cache.description: Skip the 30-day cache read (same as `X-Router-Cache` bypass); the fresh answer is still written.

candidates.description: Hit — profile URLs, winner first (`linkedin_url` + `agrees`). Non-delivery — `provider` + hop `status` only; never a URL, slug, or person name.

confidence.description: High requires independent confirmation (two agreeing sources on identity-equivalent slugs, or a slug that contains both requested name tokens). One source = medium; a disagreement = low. Kept on a below-floor withhold.

linkedin_url.description: Canonical `https://www.linkedin.com/in/<slug>` of the winning profile; hit only.

person.description: The matched profile on a hit; null otherwise (no free reverse lookup).

source.description: How the winning URL was keyed at the vendor.

status.description: `not_found` carries every non-answer; the answer's `reason_code` says why (zero_hits, person_mismatch, below_min_confidence, …).

PersonEmailExplain.description: Present on `trace.explain` only when `X-Router-Explain` / `?explain=` is `full`. Default responses omit it.

PersonEmailRequest.description: Send `first_name` + `last_name` + `company_domain` (the name route) and/or `linkedin_url` (the LinkedIn route); at least one route is required. Fields may be top level or under `person`. A packed full name on `first_name` (last blank) is split.

company_domain.description: Company website domain (`domain` is accepted as an alias). Normalized to the registrable domain.

dry_run.description: Offline and instant — no vendor hops, not cached.

external_ref.description: Client correlation key (round-trip on the run response).

linkedin_url.description: Person LinkedIn profile URL. Company pages are 400.

routing.description: `path` picks speed | balance | accuracy | coverage ( omit = balance). `only` / `ignore` isolate vendors (an unknown provider is `400 unknown_provider`). `max_provider_credits` below the path price is `max_credits_reached` (noop, 0 credits).

skip_cache.description: Skip the 30-day cache read (same as `X-Router-Cache` bypass); a fresh hit is still written.

candidates.description: Found — one row per source with `email` + `agrees`; a source whose different address lost a coverage cross-check is `agrees: false` with no `email`. Non-delivery — `provider` + `route` + hop `status` only; never an address.

confidence.description: Two independent sources = high; one = medium; a coverage conflict settled by cross-checks = low. Kept on a below-floor withhold.

person.description: The request's identity echo on `found`; null otherwise.

route.description: Which request identifier found the address.

status.description: Only `found` delivers (and bills). `conflict`, `catch_all` and `not_found` bill 0; the answer's `reason_code` says why (zero_hits, person_mismatch, no_match, sources_disagree, below_min_confidence, compliance_blocked, provider_error, …).

name.description: English display name (e.g. German); the code when unknown

source.description: ProviderName that supplied the signal, or `derived` (work-email country domain).

first_name.description: Match-only — rejects a profile that belongs to someone else. Never a language signal.

last_name.description: Match-only — rejects a profile that belongs to someone else. Never a language signal.

PersonLanguageRequest.description: One of `email` or `linkedin_url` is required (top level or under `person`).

external_ref.description: Client correlation key (round-trip on the run response).

skip_cache.description: Skip the 30-day cache read (same as `X-Router-Cache` bypass); the fresh answer is still written.

detected.description: False when no language evidence was found at all.

english.description: Can we engage in English? `yes` = English evidence at medium or high; `likely` = only low English evidence; `unconfirmed` = other languages found, no English (never "no"); `unknown` = nothing detected.

languages.description: Every candidate, ranked, with evidence. Low guesses appear only here.

local_language.description: Strongest non-English language (localized sequences / ads). Medium or high only.

recommended_language.description: Language to engage in (ISO 639-1). English whenever `english=yes`. Medium or high only, except conflict / unconfirmed_identity keep the best guess at low.

PersonNameRequest.description: One of `email` or `linkedin_url` is required (top level or under `person`).

external_ref.description: Client correlation key (round-trip on the run response).

last_name_fallback.description: Optional. Omit (default) and last_name stays null when none is found. When set, this exact string fills result.last_name if no last name is found, the response is flagged last_name_placeholder, and it is never billed or counted as a hit. Decided per call; never cached. Recommended for direct Salesforce import: "Unknown".

salesforce_safe.description: Adds result.salesforce with Salesforce-ready first/last (FirstName <= 40, LastName <= 80 UTF-16 units, control / zero-width / emoji removed). Canonical name fields are unchanged.

phone.description: Accepted, never looked up — phone-only marks `unsupported_input` (0 credits).

routing.description: `path` picks speed | balance | accuracy | coverage ( omit = balance). `only` / `ignore` isolate vendors (an unknown provider is `400 unknown_provider`). `zoominfo` is honored — workspace BYOK only. `websearch` is honored as an opt-in public web-search name verify. `max_provider_credits` below the path price is `max_credits_reached` (noop, 0 credits).

skip_cache.description: Skip the 30-day cache read (same as `X-Router-Cache` bypass); the fresh answer is still written.

x_handle.description: Accepted, never looked up — X-only marks `unsupported_input` (0 credits).

first_name_confidence.description: Optional. Present when first and last are scored separately. Overall answer.confidence is the lower of the two. High requires independent confirmation.

last_name_confidence.description: Optional. Present when first and last are scored separately. Overall answer.confidence is the lower of the two. High requires independent confirmation.

evidence.description: Present when a writeable name was withheld below the confidence floor.

first_name.description: Proper-cased (`properCaseName`); salutations, honorifics, suffixes, pronouns, emoji and URLs stripped.

first_name_confidence.description: Optional write signal for first_name when first and last are scored separately. Omitted when first_name is not returned. Overall confidence is the lower of the two component scores. High requires independent confirmation.

last_name_confidence.description: Optional write signal for last_name when first and last are scored separately. Omitted when last_name is not returned. Overall confidence is the lower of the two component scores. High requires independent confirmation.

matched_on.description: Which request identifier(s) the name came from.

name_source.description: vendor = a matched profile; email_local_parse = low-confidence local-part guess (`parsed_only`).

person.description: The matched profile on a hit; null otherwise (no free reverse lookup).

quality_flags.description: Weak-name markers on a delivered first/last. Null when none. Does not change billing or outcome; do not write a flagged name — follow `next_steps`. Detected deterministically.

salesforce.description: Present only when output.salesforce_safe is true.

ready.description: True iff last_name is non-empty after the Salesforce transform (fallback counts).

would_apply_last_name_fallback.description: Dry-run echo. true when last_name_fallback is set; unknown when omitted. Live runs omit this.

first_name.description: Match-only — rejects a profile that belongs to someone else. Never infers.

last_name.description: Match-only — rejects a profile that belongs to someone else. Never infers.

max_results.description: Ranked-list cap, default 3. Does not change which numbers are searched.

phone_types.description: Request filter. Omit or [] = any type.

PersonPhoneRequest.description: One of `email` or `linkedin_url` is required (top level or under `person`).

domain.description: Company domain (alias `company_domain`); with first+last name unlocks name+domain finders. Defaults to the email domain (not free-mail).

external_ref.description: Client correlation key (round-trip on the run response).

format.description: Which format fills `number` on `best_phone` and every `phones[]` entry. Every entry also carries `e164` and all formats in `formats`, whatever you pick. Presentation only: it is not part of the cache key, so switching format replays the cached answer at 0 credits.

phone_types.description: Omit or [] = any type. Shapes `best_phone` / `phones`; a vendor that can return none of these types is not called (0 credits).

routing.description: `path` picks the router mode (speed = cheapest/fastest; balance = best single number, default; accuracy = agreement required; coverage = several numbers). `only` / `ignore` filter the vendor pool (an unknown provider is `400 unknown_provider`). `order` is ignored — the planner orders vendors per request.

skip_cache.description: Skip the 30-day cache read (same as `X-Router-Cache` bypass); the fresh answer is still written.

best_phone.description: Best number honoring the request filter; null on a miss.

flags.description: `conflicting_numbers`: two or more providers answered and the best number is not corroborated by all of them. `numbers_dropped`: at least one returned number was invalid, junk, or not a direct dial.

person.description: The matched profile on a hit; always null on a miss (no free reverse lookup).

phones.description: Matching numbers, deduped by E.164, ranked safe-to-write first, then mobile, then confidence, then vendor order; capped at `max_results`. Invalid (libphonenumber), junk (repeated / sequential digits, NANP 555-01xx), not-direct-dial and switchboard numbers are dropped.

company_domain.description: Match-only current employer. Never steers routing.

fields.description: Canonical requested fields (deduped, in title / seniority / function order).

first_name.description: Match-only — rejects a profile that belongs to someone else. Never infers.

last_name.description: Match-only — rejects a profile that belongs to someone else. Never infers.

PersonTitleRequest.description: One of `email` or `linkedin_url` is required (top level or under `person`).

company_domain.description: Match-only current employer. A vendor title at a different employer is never a hit (`employer_mismatch`).

external_ref.description: Client correlation key (round-trip on the run response).

fields.description: Omit or [] = all three. The run continues until every requested field is answered; a vendor that can feed none of them is not called (0 credits).

routing.description: `path` picks speed | balance | accuracy | coverage ( omit = balance). `only` / `ignore` isolate vendors (an unknown provider is `400 unknown_provider`). `max_provider_credits` below the path price is `max_credits_reached` (noop, 0 credits).

skip_cache.description: Skip the 30-day cache read (same as `X-Router-Cache` bypass); the fresh answer is still written.

answered_fields.description: Requested fields that were answered. On `fields_incomplete` this names what was found while the values stay withheld (bills 0).

company.description: Current employer the title belongs to; hit only.

person.description: The matched profile on a hit; always null otherwise (no free reverse lookup).

sources.description: accuracy / coverage with `title` requested — every usable vendor title and whether it agrees.

title.description: Cleaned current title (headline tail, emoji and ` at Company` stripped); null unless requested and hit.

linkedin_url.description: Preferred LinkedIn for the job-change check; else person identifiers; else a paid email-to-profile lookup on auto/accuracy/coverage unless allow_paid_linkedin_lookup is false

external_ref.description: Client correlation key (round-trip on the run response).

confidence.description: Per-number trust. Vendor primary = high, other vendor numbers = medium, independent multi-source agreement = high; a country or line-type contradiction lowers it one level.

consensus.description: Vendor agreement on this number among the vendors that answered.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of the number's region; null for non-geographic numbers.

do_not_call.description: Vendor-native do-not-call flag; null when no vendor says.

flags.description: Verification flags. `country_mismatch`: the number's calling code differs from the person's (or company's) known location. `email_country_mismatch`: only the email ccTLD disagrees (informational). `line_type_mismatch`: the vendor said mobile, the numbering plan says otherwise. Toll-free / premium / shared-cost / pager numbers and the company switchboard are never returned as a person's number (dropped; see `numbers_dropped`).

line_type.description: libphonenumber line type from the numbering plan. US/Canada numbers are `fixed_line_or_mobile` — the plan cannot tell; this is not a carrier lookup.

number.description: The number in the requested `format` (default E.164 without spaces or punctuation, e.g. +13133383662 — the original contract).

source.description: ProviderName that supplied the number first.

sources.description: Every provider that returned this number (cross-source agreement).

type.description: Answer type. The numbering plan wins when it is definitive (libphonenumber `mobile` → mobile, `fixed_line` → landline, VoIP / toll-free / premium → other); otherwise the vendor label (some vendors label every number mobile — `type: "mobile"` and `type: "other"` alike). `phone_types` filters on this field.

PricingCapability.description: One capability's prices. Also embedded in the capability POST as `x-kingminos-pricing` (generated by `npm run pricing:spec`).

max_credits_ceiling.description: Server-side credit ceiling (code default). A request may lower it, never raise it.

opt_in_hops.description: Off-default hops that bill their own price when they decide.

outcome_priced.description: True when a delivered answer bills one path price, whatever hops ran.

PricingDeliveredRange.description: Hop-priced path: the delivered charge is the billing steps that answered, clamped to the path cap.

max.description: Most a delivered answer can bill on this path (the path cap).

min.description: Cheapest delivered answer on this path.

typical.description: typical is set only when the code fixes one delivered price for the path; otherwise null and consumers show min–max.

byok.description: Flat BYOK router fee (per answer or per billing hop; see `byok_basis`).

cap.description: Max provider credits the path may reserve (default `max_provider_credits`).

delivered.description: Credits for a delivered answer. A number on outcome-priced capabilities (one price per answer); a `{ min, typical, max }` range on hop-priced ones.

miss.description: A miss, blank, withheld answer, error or timeout bills 0.

PricingResponse.description: Public pricing table. Generated from `src/pricing-table.ts`; the API code is the only place a price is written (docs/pricing.md).

byok_flat_fee_credits.description: Flat router fee when a step runs on your own vendor key.

free_daily_credits.description: Free credits per eligible workspace per UTC day (non-stacking).

onboarding_grants.description: One-time grants in credits, once per verified work-email domain.

pricing_version.description: Content hash of the table. Changes whenever any price changes; also the `ETag`.

ProviderName.description: Stable provider ids. `dns` / `site_probe` are keyless infrastructure hops on `company.domain` (0 credits). `favicon` is the keyless house favicon-fetch hop on `company.icon` (0 credits; hosted PNG on logos.kingminos.com).         `wikidata` / `gleif` / `rdap` are keyless registry hops on `company.domain` accuracy+ additional/family evidence (0 credits). `prospeo`, `apollo` and `lemlist` are BYOK company lookups, off every default path — `routing.only` / explicit `order` only. `cognism` / `lusha` / `starbridge` / `clay` / `databar` / `quickenrich` / `getleads` / `blitzapi` are credential vendors only (Your Keys store/verify; no routing hop yet) — `routing.only` / explicit order rejects them.

ProviderOperation.description: Attempt operation ids (audit / `explain=full`). `company_search_by_name` is a company name search. `entities_by_id` is a registry entity read. `dns_lookup` / `site_probe` / RDAP `company_search_by_domain` are keyless company.domain hops. `corporate_hierarchy_enrich` is the company.hierarchy lookup. `company_linkedin_enrich` is a company social-URL lookup on company.b2b_social. `company_icon_by_domain` is a logo lookup on company.icon. `company_description_by_domain` is a description lookup; `company_description_compose` composes one (accuracy + coverage). `person_profile_by_linkedin` is a profile read on person.language. `title_search_by_email` / `title_search_by_linkedin` are the person.title hops.

RelatedDomain.description: A corporate-family host (subsidiary, parent, sister; regional when family_policy is separate_regional). Use for parent/child review, not a HubSpot additional-domain merge.

description.description: One line on what this path or endpoint adds. No vendor names.

est_credits.description: Path price from the same constants as next_steps. Never a guess.

inputs.description: Fields to send. A previous-step field is `{ from_endpoint, from_field }`.

path.description: Product path for this call, when the option is a path retry.

ReviewDomain.description: A host that looks brand-related and is live, but we could not prove ownership. Hold for a human — do not merge into HubSpot hs_additional_domains.

reason.description: Why this host is held. Today `brand_tied_live_unproven`.

allow_paid_linkedin_lookup.description: Paid email→LinkedIn profile lookup when no LinkedIn URL is known, then job-change. Default-on for balance/accuracy. Speed stays off. Set false to opt out. Requires max_provider_credits ≥ 13 (find + job-change). Default balance reserves 14 (validate 1 + 10 + 3). See docs/routing-presets.md and STATUS Open / revisit.

path.description: Product path. Canonical names: `speed` | `balance` | `accuracy` | `coverage` (company.resolve / company.domain / company.b2b_social / company.description; omit = `balance` on each). Legacy aliases (deprecated): `value` / `fast` / `name_only` → `speed`, `auto` → `balance`. person.verify_employment omit = `balance` (`speed` | `balance` | `accuracy` only — legacy company aliases are `400 invalid_routing`). Company.resolve: `speed` = cheap names, no paid name recovery; `accuracy` = gated corroboration; `coverage` = fill more empties. company.domain: Coverage = accuracy + related-domain recall (more ownership-proven additional_domains; often `partial`). Use CompanyDomainRoutingRequest on POST /v1/company/domain. Employment: `speed` = email validation only; `balance` = validate + paid LinkedIn lookup when no URL + job-change check; `accuracy` = + independent corroboration. After the employment layer, ZoomInfo may append `zoominfo_contact_id` on every path (estimate 0; does not lower LinkedIn caps). `findymail` is a BYOK alternate validator via `only` / explicit order — never stacked on the default validator. `confidence` is not a path. Wins over `preset`. See docs/routing-presets.md.

preset.description: Back-compat alias of `path` plus `zi_stamp` (optional ZoomInfo-first). Company aliases: `name_only` and `fast` (deprecated → `speed`); `value` / `auto` (deprecated → `speed` / `balance`). Employment accepts `speed` | `balance` | `accuracy` only — `name_only` / `fast` / `zi_stamp` / `value` / `auto` / `coverage` are `400 invalid_routing`. Prefer `path` on new callers.

path.description: Product path after expand (canonical). company.resolve, company.domain, company.b2b_social, company.icon, and company.description emit `speed` | `balance` | `accuracy` | `coverage`. person.verify_employment emits `speed` | `balance` | `accuracy`. Legacy request aliases are not echoed.

RunEnvelopeBase.description: Live RunResponse envelope (schema_version 2). Automations branch on answer.outcome (employment) or es_decision (Salesforce / stamp-safe). `trace` is audit/debug only (`explain=full`). Business misses stay HTTP 200.

agent_guidance.description: `person.name` only. Instructs the calling agent to present `options[]` and let the user decide. Not in `openapi.es.yaml`.

candidates.description: Miss / ambiguous candidates, including `linkedin_url`. Present only when the run did not hit and at least one candidate existed. Survives default explain — do not require `trace`.

compliance.description: Echo of active request constraints (`true` keys only). Omitted when unconstrained.

error.description: Failure message on `failed` GET /v1/runs/:id. Null otherwise.

feedback_hint.description: Agent clients only (requests that send `X-KingMinos-Client`, e.g. the KingMinos MCP server and CLI). One sentence pointing at `submitFeedback`, present on miss / ambiguous / error / reject and low-confidence answers; absent on hits and noop skips. Never sent to callers without the header (Salesforce Flow / External Services).

guide.description: Tiny pointer to GET /v1/recipes/guidance. Usually `/v1/recipes/guidance`. A blank-below-floor or low answer may add a section hash (`#below_floor`, `#low`).

next_steps.description: Machine-readable follow-ups for AI agents. Always present on completed runs (empty when there is nothing useful to do). Survives default explain. Actions: retry_with_dial | call_capability | supply_input | ask_user | review_candidates | verify_source | verify_linkedin_page | report_provider_error. Each item also carries `endpoint` (our HTTP path), `inputs` (fields to pass, including `{ from_endpoint, from_field }` for a previous step), `reason`, and `est_credits` from the path price (never a guess). Not in `openapi.es.yaml`.

options.description: `person.name` only. Every product path (speed, balance, accuracy, coverage) plus related endpoints that fill a gap, each with `est_credits` from the path price. Present on hit and miss. Show these to the user and wait — do not pick a cheaper default unless they asked. Not in `openapi.es.yaml`.

info.description:
KingMinos answers one question per capability. Send a record; get one
decision (`answer.outcome`, and `es_decision` for Salesforce), the result
fields, and a confidence.

Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <key>` (tenant `osr_` or app-minted `km_`).
Paths: `routing.path` is `speed` | `balance` | `accuracy` | `coverage`.
Credits: a call bills only when it delivers an answer; a miss bills 0.
`GET /v1/pricing` (public) is the pricing table every surface reads;
each capability POST carries its slice as `x-kingminos-pricing`.
`GET /v1/capabilities` lists each path's routing, and `GET
/v1/recipes/guidance` explains confidence, paths and floors once.
Errors: `error` is the code, `hint` the human sentence, and `detail` only
the 401 reason (see `ErrorBody`). Person endpoints answer `451
subject_suppressed` for a suppressed `email` or `linkedin_url` (0 credits).

Docs: https://kingminos.com/docs/. This document is served at `GET
/openapi.json` and `GET /openapi.yaml`; `/v1/*` responses link it with RFC
8631 `rel=service-desc`.

get.description: Session cookie or a `km_` token that explicitly carries the `billing:read` scope (`capability:*` does not imply it; the default mint set includes it). Customer `osr_` tenant keys get `401 not_signed_in`. Strictly read-only: it never grants the daily free credits, sweeps expired buckets, or touches a key; when today's free credits are still ungranted it reports `free_daily.will_grant_on_next_call`. Returns `available`, `in_flight`, `total`, live `by_kind[]` in draw order, `buckets[]` (workspace owner or session only; never `source_ref`), `expiring`, `expired_unswept`, `free_daily`, `plan` (subscription, PAYG), `next_refill` / `refills[]` (subscription refill uses stored `current_period_end` when it is still in the future), and `key` for `km_` callers (`spent_last_24h` is net of refunds). `used_this_cycle_usd_estimate` is a list-price estimate, not an invoice figure. `free_daily.daily_amount` is the daily free-credit amount for this workspace (the standard amount, or a different amount while a promo code applied at purchase that sets one is active).

Same auth as `GET /v1/balance` (session or a `km_` token with `billing:read`); a member key sees the same workspace-wide numbers. `method` is `trailing_average`: `rates.d1` / `d7` / `d30` are `run:` debit credits per day (expiry, lapse, and clawback are not spend), divided by the window length or the workspace age when younger. `primary_window` is `d7`, `d30` when d7 has fewer than 20 charged calls, or `d1` for a workspace under 2 days old; `confidence` is `low` below 20 charged calls on that window. `runout_at` assumes NO refills (conservative) and accounts for buckets expiring before the draw reaches them; `runout_with_refills_at` adds the projected refills (`next_refill`: free daily, PAYG line, subscription at `current_period_end`). `shortfall_before_refill` is measured to `next_major_refill` (subscription / PAYG line) when there is one. `status` is `exhausted`, `frozen`, `critical` (< 1 day), `low` (< 3 days) or `ok`. A free-daily-only workspace keeps the conservative `runout_at` but takes its status from the with-refills projection. Frozen paid credits are not burnable. The projection looks at most 400 days ahead.

200.description: Rates, runouts, next refills, and status

get.description: Same auth as `GET /v1/balance`. A cheap status read: `status` (`ok` | `low` | `critical` | `exhausted` | `frozen`, same rules as the forecast), `available`, the conservative `runout_at`, `next_refill_at`, and `advice`, a fixed English string from a short enum (zero spend, steady, spend spike, raise the monthly limit for a PAYG workspace, add credits, or fix billing when paid credits are frozen). With `?capability=<id>` the response adds `can_afford`, `capability`, and `required_credits` (the cheapest paid charge for that capability's default routing vs the spendable balance); nothing is reserved. When that default routing cannot be priced the fields stay `null` and `pricing` is `unknown` (never reported as free).

Same auth as `GET /v1/balance`; workspace owner or session only (`403 owner_required` for a member key). UTC-aligned `day` (default, span up to 400 days) or `hour` (span up to 7 days) points with `opening`, `closing`, `credits_in`, `credits_out`, `expired`, `adjustments`, `charged_calls`, plus a window `summary`. `closing` is the `balance_after` of the last ledger row before the point ends, carried forward on empty buckets. Balances exclude in-flight holds. Defaults: `until` = now; `since` = now − 30 days for `interval=day`, now − 7 days for `interval=hour`.

Same auth as `GET /v1/balance` (session or a `km_` token with `billing:read`). Newest first. `delta` is signed: debits, expiries, subscription lapses and refund clawbacks are negative; grants and refunds positive. `source` is an allow-listed enum (`free_daily`, `trial`, `onboarding`, `promo`, `admin_grant`, `subscription`, `subscription_lapse`, `payg_line`, `partner_payout`, `run`, `expiry`, `refund_clawback`, `other`) and `ref` a safe id (run id, cycle, bucket kind) or null; raw memos are never returned. Filters: `since` / `until` (ISO-8601 UTC, `until` defaults to now), repeatable `kind` (`credit` | `debit` | `adjustment`), `key_id`, `user_id`. Page with `limit` (default 50, max 200) and the `next_cursor` value as `before`. A member key sees only its own run rows (`visibility: "self"`); owner and session see all.

Session cookie or the current workspace token. Returns card/PAYG status plus the KingMinos subscription pointer. Also lists the four self-serve monthly plans (Starter $99 / 1,200, Growth $249 / 3,300, Pro $499 / 7,500, Scale $999 / 16,500; lookup keys `kingminos_sub_<tier>_monthly_v2`) and `custom` with `self_serve: false` (contact sales; no Stripe price). Subject is domain / website / email **or name** (`400 missing_subject`
when all four are blank). Name-only is allowed — it is not

and on speed / balance when `hint` is sent. The Worker never GETs linkedin.com / x.com / other social

values are at least medium; conflict with a usable candidate
returns the best guess at low plus `next_steps.verify_linkedin_page`.

1.2 / accuracy 1.4 / coverage 1.4); an opt-in house Wiza hop
(`routing.only` / `routing.order`, off every default path) that
decides bills its own price (15) instead; a miss or a blank held below
the confidence floor bills 0; BYOK stays 0.1. Hard 10 s server
budget including credit hold/settle.

`https://www.linkedin.com/company/{slug}` or null. Additive
`result.verification` and `result.evidence`
(`homepage_link` | `homepage_rendered` | `linkedin_redirect` |

(identity < 0.85), junk/PII, empty, and leftover first-person /
second-person / CTA marketing voice: factual We/Our copy is
rewritten to third person, otherwise the answer is a miss, so a
delivered hit has `first_person` and `cta` false. Hype, tagline,
same-as-speed, truncated, and grammar are `result.flags`, not
misses. `truncated` forces confidence `low`. `grammar` is
informational and does not affect confidence.

or trim to a whole sentence/word. Accents transliterate via

customers in the evidence.

`path` runs the balance ladder under the default routing cap of 6.
`accuracy` cap 3
(composed under 10s from request start). `coverage` cap 6 is the
highest-fill path at balance quality; it cannot miss where
accuracy hit.
`answer.confidence` is `high` | `medium` | `low` (high needs a
live homepage and a strong identity match) and is the write signal.
Vendor-returned text is at least medium unless `truncated` / `cta`
keep it low. Optional `min_confidence` overrides the path floor.

(`usage.credits.by_provider` / `usage.hops`); rejected / lost
hops and misses are 0.

- `speed` — fastest. Floor low. 2 credits on a hit.
- `balance` — two independent sources. Floor medium. 3 credits on

- `accuracy` — withholds rather than guesses: a LinkedIn URL is
  returned only when independently confirmed (two sources, exact

accent-insensitive), or a slug that contains both requested name

with `single_source`. One source is `medium`; disagreeing sources

withheld answer and a timeout bill 0. When the answer comes from your

`linkedin_url` (one is required); `phone` / `x_handle` are accepted
but never looked up (`unsupported_input`, 0 credits).

Salutations, titles, honorifics, suffixes, pronouns, emoji and URLs
are stripped deterministically (`cleanPersonName`) on every vendor
candidate — zero spend. The judge classifies only an
ambiguous multi-token split (≥2 kept words with no last name, or
≥3 words), on balance and above, with ≥1.5 s remaining: it fills a
null side at ≥0.7 and overrides the deterministic split only at
≥0.85. A judge failure never fails the hop.

Paths (`routing.path`, omit = `balance`; `value` / `fast` /
`name_only` → speed, `auto` → balance):
- `speed` — fastest; never `high`. 1 credit on a hit.
- `balance` — more sources and checks; never `high`. 2 credits on
  a hit.
- `accuracy` — the judge on ambiguous splits; `high` requires
  independent confirmation (two agreeing vendors alone stay below
  `high` and are withheld at the default high floor, billing 0);
  a disagreement is `conflict` (bills 0, flags `conflicting_names`).
  3 credits on a hit.
- `coverage` — highest fill. 5 credits on a hit.

Outcome-priced: a hit bills the path price once on the deciding
attempt; a miss, a conflict, a below-floor withhold and a timeout bill
0. When the answer comes from your own key (BYOK) a delivered hit bills
a flat 0.1 credit instead of the path price; you pay your vendor
directly. An email local-part split is a last resort only (`parsed_only`, low
confidence, flagged `email_local_parse`); a role address (`admin@`,
`info@`, …) is never a person (`role_address`, 0 credits). `matched_on`
says which request identifier(s) the name came from. Write signal is
`answer.confidence` only (no `safe_to_write` fields). Default floors:
speed/coverage low, balance medium, accuracy high; optional
`min_confidence` overrides. Below-floor blanks the name fields and keeps
candidates in `result.evidence`. 30-day D1 cache keyed on path +
`min_confidence` + `routing.only` / `ignore` (replay 0 credits;
`skip_cache`,
`X-Router-Cache: bypass`, `Cache-Control: no-cache` skip the read).
`DELETE /v1/subjects/{subject_key}` purges cached answers. A
suppressed `email` / `linkedin_url` is `451 subject_suppressed` at 0
credits before any cache, hop, run, or hold.

Optional `last_name_fallback` (recommended `"Unknown"` for a direct
Salesforce import) fills `result.last_name` when none was found,
flags `last_name_placeholder`, and never changes outcome or credits.
It is decided per call and is not in the cache key. Opt-in
`output.salesforce_safe` adds `result.salesforce` (FirstName ≤ 40,
LastName ≤ 80 UTF-16 units) without changing the canonical name
fields. API tenants only — not in `openapi.es.yaml`, no Contact/Lead
stamping.

Send `email` and `linkedin_url` together when you have both. A
workspace ZoomInfo key (`PUT /v1/credentials/zoominfo`) improves
fill, and `accuracy` reaches `high` mostly with it.
`first_name_confidence` / `last_name_confidence` are optional; fall
back to `answer.confidence`. A miss, a below-floor withhold, or a
name with `quality_flags` is never a dead end: `next_steps` names
the next endpoint (`/v1/person/b2b-social` when no `linkedin_url`
was sent; one `person.name` retry on `balance` after `speed`),
the `inputs` to pass, and `est_credits` from the path price.

endpoints, with path prices) and `agent_guidance`: present those

post.description:
For outbound dialing and contactability gates. Input is an `email` (the
Smartlead / Clay primary) or a `linkedin_url` (one is required);
`first_name` / `last_name` are used only to reject a profile that
belongs to someone else (`person_mismatch`) — a name never infers
anything.

"A wrong value is
worse than a missing one" — numbers without a `+` country code are
dropped, never guessed. Conflicting numbers return the best guess
at low confidence with all candidates in `phones[]`.

Agent-managed router, answers in < 10 s. A vendor behind a delivered
number that ran on your own key (BYOK) bills a flat 0.1 credit instead
of its price. Sources run under a ~8.5 s budget; a source not
back in time is dropped (bills 0).
`routing.path` is the product:
`speed` — fastest sources only, cap 10;
`balance` (default) — best single number by source, region and
line type, no waiting for agreement;
`accuracy` — exactly one number (`conflicting_numbers` caps it at low,
so the default high floor withholds it and bills 0; verify the candidates);
`coverage` — up to 5 ranked numbers, each returned
number's vendor bills, cap 58. `consensus` and `do_not_call` are on every
number (consensus gates safety only in accuracy). Only vendors behind
returned numbers bill, capped at the path cap (speed 10 / balance and accuracy 38 / coverage 58); a miss bills 0.

Optionality: `phone_types` filters the answer
(`mobile` | `landline` | `other` | `unknown`; omit = any) and
`max_results` (1–10, default 3) caps the ranked list. The response
returns the typed ranked `phones` (mobile first) plus a `best_phone`
honoring the filter. A vendor that can return none of the requested
types is not called: 0 credits,
`insufficient_input` (`noop`).

Output format: every phone carries `e164`,
`formats` (`e164`, `international`, `national`, `digits`,
`digits_national`), `country_code` and `calling_code`; the optional
`format` request field (default `e164`) picks which one fills
`number`. Backward compatible: omit it and `number` stays E.164.

Verification (no extra vendor cost): every number
is checked with libphonenumber (valid + possible; invalid numbers are
dropped), typed from the numbering plan where definitive
(`line_type`), screened for junk (repeated / sequential digits, NANP
555-01xx), and checked against the person's or company's known
country. Toll-free, premium, shared-cost, pager and company
switchboard numbers are not a direct dial and are dropped. Each phone
carries `confidence`, `flags` and `sources`; a hit
whose only numbers were dropped is a miss and bills 0. No carrier /
HLR lookup is made — `line_type` is not proof the line is live.

`decision.outcome` `hit` iff a matching number was found; nothing →
`zero_hits` (`miss`, `result.person` null); conflicting numbers across
vendors → `conflicting_numbers` flag; no vendor answered →
`provider_error` (`error`) or the skip reason (`noop`).
30-day D1 cache keyed on the request filter: a repeat call replays with
`usage.cached: true` at 0 credits; `skip_cache`,
`X-Router-Cache: bypass`, or `Cache-Control: no-cache` skip the read
(the fresh answer is still written). `DELETE /v1/subjects/{subject_key}`
purges cached answers. API tenants only — not in `openapi.es.yaml`, no
Contact/Lead stamping.

`email` or a `linkedin_url` (one is required); `first_name` /
`last_name` are used only to reject a profile that belongs to someone
else (`person_mismatch`) — a name never infers anything.
`company_domain` is match-only: a vendor title at a different current
employer is never a hit (`ambiguous` + `employer_mismatch`).

`fields` picks the answer: any of `title`,
`seniority`, `function` (omit = all three). A vendor that can feed
none of them is not called. v1 vendors return `title`;
`seniority` / `function` are derived from it (keyword tables, then a
judge on balance and above). `result.field_sources` says how each
field was produced (`vendor` | `derived` | `jev`).

Paths (`routing.path`, omit = `balance`; `value` / `fast` /
`name_only` → speed, `auto` → balance):
- `speed` — fastest; keyword classification only, never `high`.
  1 credit on a hit.
- `balance` — more sources and checks (including your own ZoomInfo
  key when connected). 2 credits on a hit.
- `accuracy` — independent confirmation; agreement is `high`, a
  disagreement keeps the newer role and flags `conflicting_titles`.
  10 s cap. 3 credits on a hit.
- `coverage` — highest fill. 5 credits on a hit.

Outcome-priced: a hit bills the path price once;
a miss, a partial (`fields_incomplete`) and a timeout bill 0. ZoomInfo
runs only on your own key. When the answer comes from your own key
(BYOK) a delivered hit bills a flat 0.1 credit instead of the path
price; you pay your vendor directly. `decision.outcome` `hit` iff every requested field is
answered at medium or high confidence; some but not all →
`fields_incomplete` (`ambiguous`, values withheld, names in
`result.answered_fields`); headline-only or wrong-employer evidence →
`ambiguous`; nothing → `zero_hits` (`miss`, `result.person` null).
Conflicting titles return the newer role at low confidence.
Optional `min_confidence` overrides the path floor; below-floor
blanks the fields and bills as a miss.

`routing.only` / `ignore` (replay 0 credits; `skip_cache`,
`X-Router-Cache: bypass`, `Cache-Control: no-cache` skip the read).
`DELETE /v1/subjects/{subject_key}` purges cached answers. API tenants
only — not in `openapi.es.yaml`, no Contact/Lead stamping.

post.description:
Pre-flight before email. Two-field shape (2026-09-22): **employment_status**
plus optional **`zoominfo_contact_id`**.
**One email validator** per request. `findymail` is a BYOK alternate
validator only when the tenant/request explicitly selects it
(`routing.only: ["findymail"]` or an explicit `order`). Never call both
validators on the same request. No web search on this capability.
OutboundSync sets `routing.path` (`speed` | `balance` | `accuracy`; omit = `balance`).
`value` / `auto` / `coverage` / `fast` / `name_only` are `400 invalid_routing`.
`speed`: email validation + mailbox-vs-expected-company domain check
(the corrected or the as-sent domain matches, so a legacy mailbox at a
rebranded company is not a mismatch). No `email_to_profile`, no
job-change hop. Cap 0.5. Surfaces bounce status + catch-all + SEG + role
in `result.email_validation` and `decision.summary`; `result.employment`
carries the low-confidence speed verdict (`still_there` / `unknown`;
business mailbox on another domain is `unknown` with
`explain.speed_domain_check: domain_mismatch`, not `left`) with its basis
in `explain.speed_domain_check`. Confidence caps at low on speed — only
a hard-bounce block is high. Use balance/accuracy to block on employment
left.
`balance`: validate + a paid LinkedIn profile lookup when no LinkedIn URL,
then a job-change check when expected company is present. Cap 13.5
(validate 0.5 + profile 10 + job-change 3). `allow_paid_linkedin_lookup` is
default-on; set `false` to opt out. Flag still requires
`max_provider_credits` ≥ 13 (find + job-change) or `400 invalid_routing`.
`accuracy`: same + an independent corroboration lookup (cap 14.5).
An empty or failed corroboration lowers confidence — no separate abstain SKU.
After the employment decision, when a ZoomInfo key is connected and we
still lack a contact id, a ZoomInfo contact lookup by email
(`continueForContactId`) attaches `result.zoominfo_contact_id`. Id attach only —
does not overwrite person name / title / company / LinkedIn or change
`decision.outcome` / `result.employment` / confidence. A ZoomInfo miss/error/`not_configured`
keeps the employment answer. Contact id is **not** required for `es_decision: hit`
(company stamp-safe hit still needs `zoominfo_company_id`).
Decision outcomes: `high_confidence_send` | `low_confidence_send` |
`low_confidence_block` | `high_confidence_block` | `no_decision`.
Four-way answers map `es_decision` → `hit`. Catch-all / SEG / employment inform
the bucket and live in explain, not as fifth outcomes.
Default `max_provider_credits` is 13.5 (`balance`). `speed` 0.5. `accuracy` 14.5.
You are only charged when an answer is delivered: `still_there`,
`left`, or a definitive invalid mailbox. `unknown`, errors, timeouts,
and empty results bill 0. Any hop served by your own key (BYOK) bills a flat 0.1 credit.
ZoomInfo contact search estimate is 0 — does not lower LinkedIn caps.
ZoomInfo uses the same BYOK rules as company (`docs/byok-zoominfo.md`).
